verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Temporal serves an llms.txt at docs.temporal.io/llms.txt that follows the llmstxt convention as a structured index of its documentation. Several docs pages are also served as raw .md files (e.g. the encyclopedia and serverless-workers pages), which gives agents markdown-native content to read. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or other agent-specific guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.temporal.io/llms.txt # Temporal Platform Documentation
